column1: # Every tall sign of the first transcription (codes P and D): 358. shape_nonblind = second look, reader knew the hypothesis; blind_class = blind shape test on crops under random ids (A = d, B = t, C = l, D = unclear); blind for sign P only: for sign D the class C was set from the transcription code, because the classifier put most D signs in class A (raw labels in timestamps/blind_shape_test/stamped/blind_set_labels.tsv). reading = the letter the reading takes. agree = blind class and non-blind verdict give the same letter (only where both gave one).
